34001.story: As of Oct 12, the record on Atlantic County runs 75 years, from 1951 to 2025. On the middle value of the county's 6 grids, July to August came in under 90% of normal in 35 of those years, more than any other pair. In 2025 that middle ran 54% of normal in January to February and 136% in April to May. So far in 2026 it has stayed low, with February to March at 56% and May to June at 55%.

preliminary.means: an estimate from NOAA rain, not RMA's index; RMA's final index can differ
